BF1_anomalous_cert.note: Anomalous curves have odd order (#E=p), hence no rational 2-torsion and no rational 2-isogeny over F_p. Certificate verifies Smart anomalous properties only (order=p, trace=1, c_special_formula=C_special_smart). Planted-path control (CTRL-PLANTED-PATH-POS) uses a 2-isogeny walk and therefore cannot use this curve as a planted start per FIX-3.

planted_path_control.note_fp_isogeny_preserves_special_detect: F_p-rational isogenies preserve #E and N*; anomalous/MOV detectors are class invariants. FIX-3 therefore requires the recovered reverse path to be at distance >= 1 (min_hops=1) with a non-empty edge path and endpoint != search start; the depth-0 self-hit is not a recovery. The discrete-log certificate is wrapper-reverified (harness ToyEC.mul) on the planted endpoint instance (toy pullback = direct solve; no isogeny evaluation at toy scale).

sota_delta.non_solver_scope: Toy-scale ECDLP isogeny-transfer experiment. No sub-rho asymptotic claim. Charged transfer ratios R_xfer are observations only.
